user.title: Priority Command Arbitration
user.description: Give every command a level of authority, so a manual action and an automation can disagree without one silently clobbering the other. Applies to every supported entity, but changes nothing until a service call actually asks for a priority: by default all commands share the lowest level and simply replace each other, exactly as they do today.

relinquish.name: Relinquish
relinquish.description: Clear one priority slot and hand control to the next-highest command still in force.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: The slot to clear, 1 (Manual Emergency) to 5 (Manual Low).

relinquish_all.name: Relinquish all
relinquish_all.description: Clear every slot above Manual Low, returning the entity to ordinary control.

set.name: Set slot
set.description: Write a command into a priority slot directly, without going through the domain service.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: The slot to write, 1 (Manual Emergency) to 5 (Manual Low).

service.name: Service
service.description: Service name within the entity's own domain, such as turn_on.

data.name: Data
data.description: Payload for the command, such as brightness or temperature.

priority_ttl.name: Hold for
priority_ttl.description: How long the slot holds before clearing itself, as seconds or a duration. Omit or use 0 to hold until relinquished. Not valid at priority 5.

get.name: Get array
get.description: Return the full priority array for each target entity.
